title: 王玉雯代言皮草遭抵制是上纲上线吗
summary: 11月25日晚，王玉雯工作室与品牌方发声明称，合作出镜产品为皮衣等非皮草品类。此前，王玉雯近日官宣代言主打真皮草的付智恩品牌，因长期树立爱宠人设，随即引发网友抵制。

title: 《以撒的结合》DLC被曝使用未披露AI音乐，Nicalis遭差评轰炸后撤下
summary: The Binding of Isaac developer Nicalis has removed undisclosed AI-generated music included in Repentance+ after backlash led to a review-bombing campaign on Steam and a response from the game's creator, Edmund McMillen.
source_names: IGN / Eurogamer / Rock Paper Shotgun / GamesIndustry.biz

title: Capcom 恐龙射击游戏 Exoprimal 服务器明年灭绝，关服陨石已逼近
summary: Sad news dinosaur lovers. Exoprimal - Capcom's third-person sci-fi shooter with a Jurassic twist - will be shutting down next year. With its closure, the game will no longer be playable, even for those who've got it downloaded. Read more
source_names: Eurogamer / Rock Paper Shotgun / PC Gamer

title: 男子家中搜到诅咒自家8岁孩子WiFi名
summary: 近日，杭州杨先生在家中搜到名为“701小孩替人挡灾”的WiFi名，经实测601门口信号满格，报警后楼下邻居始终不露面。此前，亲戚家小孩在杨先生家玩耍发出声响，杨先生一家曾就噪音纠纷向楼下邻居当场道歉。
